adopt.why: The best debugging and billing-audit surface among the six vendors. Fix: add Indian reasons (DND, CLI/DLT, operator announcement, window) and a business-outcome field, since no vendor has one (XS-20).

adopt.pattern: A version on every write, with branches, merge proposals and a traffic split
adopt.evidence: Agent -> Branch -> immutable Version -> MergeProposal -> Deployment %; Main 100% Live badge. [o] account-phase report section 1; walkthroughs/elevenlabs 8-branches.png
adopt.why: Safe iteration and rollback are a parity floor. Fix: reject unknown fields (ElevenLabs drops them and still commits a version), skip no-op versions, make merge a policy check rather than a person-only gate, record the model actually in effect per call.

adopt.pattern: Inline price and latency on every model row, with a Detailed costs panel
adopt.evidence: LLM drawer groups by provider and shows latency range, $/min and $/msg per row. [d] walkthroughs/elevenlabs/report.md section 4, 61-llm-list.png
adopt.why: A self-serve buyer choosing a stack needs this (decision.2026-10-20.product-stack-selectable). Fix: India-measured p50/p90 with n and region, the prompt-size assumption stated, all-in INR per minute including telephony, and the same strip for ASR and voice, which ElevenLabs does not show.

adopt.pattern: A 1-2 sentence description under every setting incl. its billing impact, and explained locks
adopt.evidence: 'Each upload is billed, so this helps control cost'; 'locked because Turn V3 requires Scribe v2 Realtime'. [o] 44-agent-settings.png, walkthroughs report section 13
adopt.why: Best settings explanation of the six dashboards. Fix: show units in milliseconds and the resulting turn-taking floor, which is invisible at ElevenLabs.

adopt.pattern: Template gallery with a live flow preview and one-click use
adopt.evidence: 45+ templates with node graph preview. [o] 02-after-login.png; walkthroughs SYNTHESIS best-for-templates
adopt.why: Fastest route to a believable first agent. Fix: India templates (renewal, collections, appointment, lead qualification), AI disclosure built into each, and node text written as shapes not quotable sentences (their sample opening lines are sentence-shaped, which our recitation law says get recited).

adopt.pattern: Docked test panel with mock tools on every config page
adopt.evidence: Inline/Widget test, mock tools, debugger, history, voice settings. [o] 38-agent-builder.png, 9-preview.png
adopt.why: Test-while-editing cuts first-run time (4 clicks, 1 field to a browser test). Fix: label the start-call state, no unexplained red button, and run the same test through the phone path.

adopt.pattern: CSV contract shown before upload with per-row overrides
adopt.evidence: Required phone_number; optional prompt, first_message, voice_id, language; other columns become variables; 25 MB. [o] 33-batch-telephony-form.png, EL-05
adopt.why: Per-row personalisation is the base of campaign personalisation. Fix: row preview with a reason per rejected row, +91 normalisation, dedupe across formats, DND status and consent source per row.

adopt.pattern: Typed event taxonomy with mid-call context push and a history trimmed to what the caller heard
adopt.evidence: About 40 events: contextual_update, agent_response_correction, interrupted flag, conversation_history + resume token, vad_score, internal_turn_probability, 26 error types. [o] account-phase report section 4; account-phase SYNTHESIS lines 98-99
adopt.why: Lets memory and personalisation inject context mid-call and keeps the transcript honest after barge-in. Fix: expose the same events to VP's own agents and to customers' webhooks.

adopt.pattern: Pre-call initiation webhook plus signed post-call webhooks
adopt.evidence: Pre-call POST returns dynamic variables and overrides; HMAC ElevenLabs-Signature; auto-disable after 10+ consecutive failures. [o] account-phase report section 4
adopt.why: The hook where a per-contact memory brief can be injected before the first word (v2). Fix: delivery log with retries visible to the buyer.

adopt.pattern: Go-live checklist inside the assistant ('0 of 10 ready')
adopt.why: Turns launch readiness into a visible list. Fix: gate on predicates (disclosure present, window set, DND scrub on, end-call tool on, spend cap set), not on the assistant's opinion (rejected.harvest.03: safety by instruction leaks).

adopt.pattern: Config-as-code CLI with push/pull and a residency switch
adopt.evidence: Rust CLI behind an npm launcher; residency global/us/eu/in/sg. [o] account-phase report section 2
adopt.why: Lets teams version configs and lets the chat agent drive the same operations (W10: every dashboard action reachable by API/MCP). Fix: full API parity, including keys and billing which ElevenLabs refuses to an API key.

adopt.pattern: Three test types: LLM, tool and simulated personas with success conditions and repeat runs
adopt.evidence: Simulation success conditions (2026-06-22), agent test repeat runs (2026-06-01). [o] research/2026-10-20/teardown/elevenlabs/velocity.json; account-phase report section 1
adopt.why: Regression safety for agents. Fix: classify outcomes against verified keys, never have a model grade its own work; add Hinglish personas with pauses, backchannels and interruptions.

adopt.pattern: Conversational polish controls: soft-timeout fillers, pre-tool speech, tool interruption mode, per-language interruption ignore terms
adopt.evidence: Soft timeout filler (LLM-generated option), pre-tool speech, interruption_ignore_terms per language. [o] account-phase report section 6; velocity.json 2026-04-27, 06-08, 06-22
adopt.why: Hides tool latency and handles backchannels. Fix: ship Hindi/Hinglish seed lists on by default (theirs is empty and English), and do not copy default-on speculative generation without a negation-aware release check (rejected.2026-10-17.speculative-release: 3/58 truncated transcripts accepted, 4/4 negation flips).

adopt.pattern: Safety and privacy UX: open-allowlist warning, per-agent authentication, retention and zero-retention toggles, sentiment acknowledgement, widget consent dialog
adopt.evidence: 'Any host will be able to connect' red box; Zero Retention Mode, Store Call Audio, retention; sentiment 'Acknowledge'; terms_text/terms_html dialog. [o] 54-agent-security.png, 41-agent-analysis.png, EL-41
adopt.why: Visible warnings and consent are the right instincts. Fix: closed by default, retention and redaction chosen at onboarding, DPDP notice and recording consent injected into phone calls (ElevenLabs injects nothing).
